messages:
marta.k: heads up — we had a customer hit a delivery loop for their tenant audit export. their downstream webhook kept returning 500 and our worker retried forever. wondering if we should change default retry policy for tenant exports or surface more detail in console.
john.lee: ouch. what retry behavior is currently in code? exponential backoff with max attempts?
samir: current behavior = 5 retries, exponential, then DLQ creation. but DLQ is internal and invisible unless you know the job id. customers just see 'failed'.
ella.ops: can we at least show a link in the export job row to the DLQ items + last 5 errors? that would save support time.
marta.k: yes — console link makes sense. also we should add a per-tenant retry cap override (customer can opt-in to longer retries for guaranteed delivery).
john.lee: allow override but default should be conservative for compliance exports. infinite retry is bad if webhook is misconfigured and leaking PII.
compliance-bot: note: retention and redaction rules apply to retries; if export contains PII we must mask before any re-delivery attempts beyond first failure.
samir: good call. we can annotate export bundle with redaction-mode: none|mask|strip and have worker apply it before each delivery attempt. small perf hit but safer.
ella.ops: UX: add a dropdown on export config: Retry policy -> (Default: 5 attempts, 2s->32s backoff) | Custom (enter attempts + cap) | Disabled (fail-fast). Show telemetry expected cost.
marta.k: telemetry: we need metrics per-tenant: retry_count, last_error_code, dlq_count, time_to_first_success, and a histogram of delivery latency. these should be queryable in console and in the alerts api.
john.lee: also emit idempotency-key with each webhook payload so downstreams can dedupe if we re-send after partial success. propose header: X-RW-Export-Idempotency: <uuid-v4>.
samir: +1. add signature header too (X-RW-Signature) so customers can verify origin. we already sign file bundles.
ella.ops: can we include a preview link in failed emails? "View recent failures" that opens job details with logs and redaction snapshot.
marta.k: governance question: should retries for tenant exports count against their quota? right now they're not charged for retries — that can be gamed.
john.lee: they should count towards delivery units — otherwise cost/accounting mismatch. but mark the metric as retry_tokens so billing can treat differently.
compliance-bot: export delivery audit trail should record actor (system-worker), attempt_number, error_code, and the export bundle fingerprint. required for SOC reports.
samir: implementation note: change worker to persist attempts as child entries of export_job. add a compact event shape for downstream export telemetry: {job_id, attempt, status, code, duration_ms, idempotency_key} — will emit to metrics stream.
marta.k: sample webhook callback signature in case helpful:
```
POST /webhook
Headers:
  X-RW-Export-Idempotency: 9f8b7a1e-2c3b-4c55-a8d2-0d1e2f3a4b5c
  X-RW-Signature: sha256=abcd1234...
Body: {"tenant":"acme", "export_id":"job-1234", "bundle_url":"https://s3.redwood/bundles/job-1234.zip"}
```
john.lee: sounds good. next steps: samir to draft worker DB change + metric emit, ella to mock console row + failure panel, marta to write a short policy doc for default retry + override rules.
ella.ops: I'll also add an item to support playbook: how to diagnose stuck exports.
ops-bot: deploy-check: export-worker schema migration planned for 4150002000 - breaking changes: new attempts table column. (reaction: :eyes:)
samir: will send PR later today. rough ETA for end-to-end (worker + console + telemetry) = 2 sprints if no blockers.
marta.k: thanks — can we also surface a small tooltip in console: "Retries may re-send data — ensure webhook expects idempotent delivery or enable redaction."
john.lee: agreed. small wording tweak then we can merge design and infra tickets. :thumbsup:
